issues.status: Confirmed source conflict; not reproduced in BioLab
issues.issue: The refractory-period paragraph states that a single impulse largely reverses ionic distributions and that the pump must restore them before another impulse. On the same page the common-mistake box correctly distinguishes rapid K-channel repolarization from pumping.
issues.handling: C2.2.8 explains Na-channel inactivation/recovery and delayed K-channel effects. Pumps maintain gradients over many impulses; the bulk ion concentrations do not reverse during one impulse. No universal refractory duration or maximum firing frequency is asserted.
